title: Acting: face, body and hand gestures chosen by what the sentence does

entries.when: choosing a hand or body gesture for a sentence
entries.do: list-item: count on fingers or point to the item; contrast ('but', 'instead'): two hands split left/right; emphasis word: beat gesture (a small chop) on the keyword time; question: palm up, head tilt 6 degrees; uncertainty: shrug; reveal: both hands open, step back; warning: palm out; hook: lean-in with a pointing hand; CTA: point down or at the viewer. Return to rest between sentences.

evidence.note: host: point up, point sideways, thinking, surprised, wink, hands up across 65 s
idle, explain, point, think, shrug, wave, cheer, lean-in, step-back...

anti_patterns: gesture held for more than 3 s
same gesture twice in a row

entries.when: choosing a facial expression for a line
entries.do: Map emotion to brows/eyes/mouth: curious = one brow up, eyes to the object; alarmed = brows up and in, eyes wide, mouth small O; smug = half-lid, one side smile; deadpan = flat mouth, slow blink; excited = brows up, big open smile; sad = brows up and in at the inner ends, mouth down; angry = brows down and in. Expression changes 150-250 ms BEFORE the word that carries it.

evidence.note: sweating worried face, grin, glaring glasses face
red glowing eyes on the threat beat
raised brow, flat mouth on the dev; square eyes on the mascot

anti_patterns: mouth movement with no brow change

entries.when: any character on screen longer than 1.5 s
entries.do: Blink every 3-5 s (random within), a long blink on a beat of doubt; eye-dart 5-10 degrees toward the thing mentioned 120 ms before the word; look at the camera on the CTA; never freeze the eyes.

evidence.note: the only motion in a 82 s film is the eyes sliding sideways and blinking

anti_patterns: blink on the exact same frame in two characters

entries.do: Breathing (chest or scale 1 %, 3.5 s cycle), weight shift every 4-6 s, small head tilt when thinking, a settle (0.2 s overshoot) when a pose ends; no perfectly still frames.

evidence.note: engine already adds breathing, weight shift, head life and blinks on top of poses

anti_patterns: robotic loops with a visible seam

entries.when: a surprising line is spoken by another character
entries.do: Cut to the listener within 0.3 s of the line start; the reaction is a different emotion from the speaker; hold 0.8-1.2 s; the listener's eyes go to the speaker or the object.

evidence.note: close-up of the sweating boy when the host announces the rules

entries.when: a mascot and a human share the screen
entries.do: The mascot is symmetric, smaller and bouncier (squash and stretch on emphasis, a 3 degree wobble), speaks with its whole body; the human is asymmetric, gestures with one hand, reacts with the eyebrows; keep eye lines crossing.

evidence.note: mascot with square eyes and tiny legs, dev with big glasses
spiky fruit mascot vs freckled human
